text:
Hello everyone,
I have my final a5 appointment coming up in a few days in Misrad Hapnim Jerusalem and it was scheduled a year prior at last year’s a5 interview. We submitted the required documents 3 months ago, but have not heard back from misrad Hapnim to confirm.

Does anyone know if this is normal, should we just show up despite not hearing from them? 

Another thing I’m concerned with is asking about applying for citizenship, based on time I was supposed to be able to apply last year, but because it was only our 3rd meeting they became weird and suspicious despite have been on an a5 for 4 years already. I have a family with 4 children, I don’t understand why it was interrogated for asking and now I’m worried about asking about it this time around. Can anyone suggest how I should handle that conversation if they become combative again? I know it’s my right at this point but I’m still a bit nervous. 

Many thanks,

🙏🏻
